message.content:
A magazine cover titled TEMPO in large red capital letters against a black background. Above the title, two phrases are separated by a slash: "ASAL-MUASAL ISU RESHUFFLE" and "TARIK-ULUR SENGKETA PAJAK GOOGLE". Below the title, the words "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appear in smaller red letters.

The central image is a rusted metal porthole with a round window. Behind a wire mesh screen, a human hand with dark, weathered skin reaches forward. The fingers are bent, grasping the mesh. The porthole frame is metallic and weathered with visible rivets. 

Below the porthole, the word "INVESTIGASI" is printed in white. Beneath that, the headline "BUDAK INDONESIA DI KAPAL TAIWAN" appears in large, bold white capital letters. A block of white text below explains that Indonesian crew members on illegal routes were mistreated on foreign ships, and those who resisted were imprisoned, following a Tempo investigation in Taipei. 

A barcode is located in the bottom left corner, accompanied by the dates "9-15 JANUARI 2017", price "RP 45.000", and other publishing details. The left edge features a solid red vertical stripe.
